domain.name: abstract circulant point-line incidence on Z/7 with difference set {0,1,2}
domain.description: Two opaque seven-element sorts and a 21-row incidence relation, matched to the 017.24 Fano successor on every cardinality but deliberately not a projective plane.
domain.source_semantics: A point-line pair is marked exactly when its two opaque members occur in one declared incidence row. Raw identifiers carry no order, coordinate, probability, or answer meaning. The integers in the identifier names carry no declared arithmetic; the relation is declared extensionally by its 21 rows.
domain.why_this_fixture: On the 017.24 Fano successor the automorphism group is transitive on marked and on unmarked pairs, so the derived class partition coincides with the declared relation together with its complement. That degeneracy makes 017.24 unable to separate compiling a derived quotient from indexing by the relation the schema already states. Here the derived partition strictly refines the declared relation, so the two are separated by construction.

admitted_inputs.generator: Every ordered pair (point, line) from the two declared sorts.

equivalence.raw_presentation_equivalence: Two raw presentations of an admitted input are equivalent exactly when a sort-preserving incidence automorphism carries one point-line pair to the other.

automorphisms.definition: All independent point and line permutations that preserve the declared incident relation.
automorphisms.expectation_status: redundant self-check on a quantity the compiler derives independently from the sorts and the relation alone

declared_symmetry_ladder.purpose: Each rung is a distinct declaration of how much presentation equivalence the Type Schema states. A rung declares a generating set; the compiler closes it and derives the surviving free parameters. The ladder is the dose axis for the experiment: more declared symmetry, fewer parameters left for Training.
declared_symmetry_ladder.closure_rule: close the declared generating set under composition, then partition the admitted inputs into the classes of the closure's action

derivable_self_checks.naming_constraint: Derived classes are reported as O_0 through O_3, ordered by cardinality then by least member. The names are bookkeeping and carry no answer meaning.
derivable_self_checks.expectation_status: redundant self-check; the compiler reads only sorts and relations and must reproduce these numbers without consulting this block

answer_type.name: BinaryAnswer
answer_type.semantics: Two neutral, unordered, mutually exclusive and exhaustive answer labels. The answer type is binary regardless of how many classes the compiler derives; a class carries a frequency of a_0, not an answer of its own. The labels are opaque names with no source meaning and no declared relationship to any sort, relation, or derived class.

not_declared_here: any total or partial assignment from admitted inputs to answer labels
any statement that the declared relation determines an answer label
any statement that a derived class determines an answer label
any decision procedure of any kind
compiler_visible_semantics: the declared generating set of the rung being compiled
the induced equivalence classes on admitted inputs
the arity and the neutral labels of the answer type
compiler_forbidden_semantics: answer label stored as an input field
independence_fence: This fixture is constructed for 017.24a and reuses no banked catalogue, habitat support, hidden label, or learning target. It is an abstract circulant incidence structure, chosen because its automorphism group is transitive on neither the marked nor the unmarked pairs.
